query: SELECT o.id, o.template_id, coalesce((SELECT min(d.received_at) FROM messaging.delivery_event d WHERE d.provider_sid = o.provider_sid AND d.status = 'delivered'), o.sent_at, o.created_at) AS "at!" FROM messaging.outbox o WHERE o.recipient_id = $1 AND $2 = ANY(o.subject_ids) AND o.template_id = ANY($3::text[]) AND o.status NOT IN ('blocked', 'failed', 'expired') ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 1
